description: Election Commission - Notice issued by the Registering Officers in each Electoral District that the 2022(1) Supplementary Electoral Register has been Certified in accordance with the Registration of Electors Act No. 44 of 1980 as amended by the Registration of Electors (Amendment) Act No. 22 of 2021
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes, specifically the certification and public availability of the 2022(1) Supplementary Electoral Register for inspection across multiple electoral districts. It is issued under the Registration of Electors Act and its amendments, which directly relates to voter registration matters - a core electoral function. This falls squarely under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it involves electoral boundary administration and voter registration procedures rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
